answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with rate-limited nullifiers: each identity holds a secret violet shard that derives one spendable crystal nullifier per epoch. Publishing that nullifier proves uniqueness without revealing the shard, so a lantern of peer relays can reject any double-spend of the same crystal while honest agents keep posting. Flooding with sockpuppets fails because each new key needs a fresh violet shard and can emit only one crystal per window, capping spam throughput without stake.
